qe: Which of the following is the smallest particle of an element that retains its chemical identity and participates in chemical reactions?
qh: किसी तत्व का वह सूक्ष्मतम कण कौन सा है जो रासायनिक अभिक्रियाओं में भाग लेता है और अपनी रासायनिक पहचान बनाए रखता है?
e: Atom (paramaanu) kisi tatv (element) ka sabse chhota aisa kan (particle) hai jo apni rasayanik pehchaan banaye rakhta hai aur rasayanik kriyon mein hissa leta hai; isse aage todne par uske aaveshit kan (electrons) aur nucleus ke kank mil jaate hain, jo tatv ki pehchaan nahi rakhte. Molecule do ya adhik atomon ka jod hota hai (jaise O2, H2O), quark proton aur neutron ke andar milne wale aur bhi chhote kan hain, aur nucleon proton ya neutron ko kehte hain. Isliye 'atom' hi sahi jod hai. Exam point: atom = tatv ka sabse chhota rasayanik-aavashyak kan; molecule atomon ka samooh hai, quark usse chhota aur nucleon nucleus ka kan hai.

qe: Who discovered the subatomic, negatively charged 'Electron' in 1897 through Cathode Ray Tube (CRT) experiments?
qh: 1897 में कैथोड किरण नलिका (CRT) प्रयोगों के माध्यम से ऋणावेशित 'इलेक्ट्रॉन' की खोज किसने की थी?
e: Electron ki khoj 1897 mein J.J. Thomson ne cathode ray tube (CRT) ke prayogon se ki thi - unhone dikhaya ki cathode rays ke kan negativ (rin) aavesh wale hain aur har padaarth mein ek jaise hote hain, isliye unhone electron ka naam diya aur uska aavesh-mass anupat (e/m) nikaala. Rutherford ne 1911 mein gold foil prayog se nucleus khoja, Chadwick ne 1932 mein neutron khoja, aur Eugen Goldstein ne 1886 mein canal rays (positive rays) khoje. Isliye electron ki khoj ka sahi naam J.J. Thomson hai - baaki vikalp kisi aur kan ya ghatna se jude hain. Exam point: electron = J.J. Thomson (1897, cathode rays); proton = Goldstein (1919 mein Rutherford ne naam diya), neutron = Chadwick (1932).

qe: The central, dense 'Nucleus' of an atom discovered by Rutherford consists of which subatomic nucleons?
qh: परमाणु के केंद्रीय नाभिक (Nucleus) में कौन से उप-परमाण्विक कण (न्यूक्लिऑन) पाए जाते हैं?
e: Nucleus ke andar do tarah ke nucleon hote hain - positively charged proton aur neutral neutron; inhi dono ka kul dravyaman (mass) nucleus ka lagbhag poora bhaar banta hai, jabki electron nucleus ke bahar chakkar lagate hain. Isi karan atom ka poora aakar (size) bahut bada hota hai par uska 99.9% se zyada bhaar chhote nucleus mein simat jaata hai. Positron khud ek alag kan hai (electron ka pratikan), aur 'electron aur neutron' milakar nucleus nahi banate kyunki electron nucleus ke bhitar sthir roop se nahi rehta. Exam point: nucleus = proton + neutron (nucleons); usme electron nahi hote - electron nucleus ke bahar parikalpa (orbit) mein rehte hain.

qe: What is the fundamental unit electric charge and resting mass of an individual Proton?
qh: एक प्रोटॉन पर कितना धनात्मक विद्युत आवेश और द्रव्यमान होता है?
e: Proton par ek ikai dhan (positive) aavesh hota hai jiska maan +1.602 x 10^-19 coulomb hai, aur uska vishraam dravyaman (rest mass) 1.672 x 10^-27 kg hota hai - yani ye electron se lagbhag 1836 guna bhaari hai. Isi karan atom ka bhaar mukhya roop se nucleus ke protonon-neutronon se juda hota hai. 'Prambhar +3.2' ya '-1.6' wale aankde galat hain, aur 'zero (neutral)' neutron ka gun hai, proton ka nahi. Yaad rakhein ki aavesh ikai (elementary charge) hi proton ka aavesh maana jaata hai aur electron ka aavesh uske bilkul barabar par rin (negative) hota hai. Exam point: proton = +1.602 x 10^-19 C aavesh aur 1.672 x 10^-27 kg dravyaman; yahi aavesh ki mool ikai (elementary charge) hai.

qe: Who proposed the first scientific 'Atomic Theory' in 1803 postulating that matter is composed of indivisible atoms?
qh: 1803 में सर्वप्रथम वैज्ञानिक 'परमाणु सिद्धांत' का प्रतिपादन किसने किया था जिसमें परमाणुओं को अविभाज्य बताया गया था?
e: John Dalton ne 1803 mein pehla vaigyanik 'paramaanu siddhant' diya, jismein kaha gaya ki padaarth chhote indivisible (na todne yogya) kanon se bana hai, ek tatv ke sabhi atom ek jaise hote hain, aur rasayanik kriya mein atom sirf juta ya alag hota hai - naya banta ya nasht nahi hota. Niels Bohr ne 1913 mein parikalpa (orbit) aur kvantam wala model diya, Amedeo Avogadro ne parimaan aur aayatan ka sambandh bataya, aur Antoine Lavoisier ko rasayanik kriya mein dravyaman-sanrakshan ka niyam dene wale ke roop mein jaana jaata hai. Isliye sabse pehla vaigyanik atomic theory Dalton ka hai. Exam point: 1803 ka pehla atomic theory = John Dalton; Bohr ka model 1913 mein aaya aur Avogadro-Lavoisier anya niyamon se jude hain.

qe: The 'Mass Number' (A) of any atomic nucleus is mathematically defined as the:
qh: किसी परमाणु की 'द्रव्यमान संख्या' (Mass Number - A) किसे दर्शाती है?
o: Total sum of Protons and Neutrons (Nucleons: A = Z + N)
Total number of protons only (Atomic Number Z)
e: Dravyaman sankhya (Mass Number, A) kisi bhi nucleus ke kul nucleon (proton + neutron) ki ginti hoti hai, isliye A = Z + N, jahan Z barsankhya (atomic number, protonon ki ginti) aur N neutronon ki ginti hai. Parsanyikaa (electron) is ginti mein nahi aate kyunki unka bhaar bahut kam hota hai aur wo nucleus ka hissa nahi hote. Atomic number Z keval protonon ki ginti batata hai aur valence electronon ki ginti rasayanik sanyojakta (valency) darshata hai - ye teeno alag shabdaavali hain. Jaise carbon-12 mein 6 proton aur 6 neutron hote hain, isliye A = 12. Exam point: mass number A = proton + neutron (Z+N); atomic number Z = keval proton; electron mass number mein nahi jodte.

qe: Nuclides of the same chemical element sharing an identical Atomic Number (Z) but differing in Mass Number (A) are termed:
qh: एक ही तत्व के वे परमाणु जिनका परमाणु क्रमांक (Z) समान लेकिन द्रव्यमान संख्या (A) भिन्न होती है, क्या कहलाते हैं?
e: Ek hi tatv ke aise nuklaid jinka atomic number (Z) saman ho par mass number (A) alag ho, unhe samasthaanik (isotopes) kehte hain - jaise hydrogen ke protium, deuterium aur tritium, ya carbon-12 aur carbon-14. Inmein protonon ki ginti (yani tatv) saman rehti hai par neutronon ki ginti alag, isliye rasayanik gun lagbhag saman par bhaar alag hote hain. Isobar alag tatv hote hain (A saman, Z alag), isotone wo hote hain jinke neutron barabar hote hain, aur isodiafer mein N aur Z ka antar saman rehta hai - yani ye teeno is sankalpana se alag hain. Exam point: isotopes = ek hi tatv, Z saman par A alag (jaise C-12 aur C-14); isobar alag tatv (A saman), isotone neutron saman, isodiafer (N-Z) saman.

qe: Which rare isotope of Hydrogen contains two neutrons and is unstable and radioactive in nature?
qh: हाइड्रोजन का कौन सा समस्थानिक (Isotope) प्राकृतिक रूप से अस्थिर और रेडियोधर्मी (Radioactive) होता है?
e: Hydrogen ke teen samasthaanik (isotopes) hain: protium (1H1) mein neutron nahi hota, deuterium (2H1 ya D) mein ek neutron hota hai aur ye sthir hai, aur tritium (3H1 ya T) mein do neutron hote hain jiski wajah se ye asthir (unstable) aur radioaktiv hota hai - iska ardh-aayu (half-life) lagbhag 12.3 saal hai aur ye beta kan chhodkar helium-3 ban jaata hai. Tritium ka istemal parmaanu astra aur self-luminous paint jaisi cheezon mein hota hai. Hydronium ek ion (H3O+) hai, isotope nahi. Isliye sahi jod tritium (3H1) hai. Exam point: do neutron wala hydrogen isotope = tritium (3H1), jo radioaktiv hai; protium mein 0 aur deuterium mein 1 neutron hota hai.

qe: Who discovered the neutral, uncharged subatomic particle 'Neutron' in 1932 by bombarding beryllium with alpha particles?
qh: 1932 में बेरिलियम पर अल्फा कणों की बमबारी करके अनावेशित 'न्यूट्रॉन' की खोज किसने की थी?
e: Neutron ki khoj 1932 mein James Chadwick ne beryllium ki patli chadar par alpha kanon ki bombari se ki thi - nikalne wali kirnon ka aavesh zero tha aur dravyaman lagbhag proton jitna, isliye unhe neutron naam diya gaya. Rutherford ne 1911 mein nucleus ka siddhant diya, J.J. Thomson ne electron (1897) aur Eugen Goldstein ne canal rays/positive rays (1886) ke aavishkar kiye the - ye sab alag aavishkar hain. Neutron ki khoj ne samasthaanikon (isotopes) aur nucleus ki banaawat ko samajhna aasan kar diya. Exam point: neutron ki khoj = James Chadwick (1932), beryllium par alpha kanon ki kriya se; neutron neutral (bina aavesh) aur proton jitna bhaari hota hai.

qe: Ernest Rutherford's iconic 1911 Gold Foil Alpha-Particle Scattering Experiment conclusively proved the existence of:
qh: 1911 में रदरफोर्ड के सोने की पन्नी पर अल्फा कण प्रकीर्णन प्रयोग ने परमाणु में किसकी खोज की?
o: The tiny, dense, positively charged Atomic Nucleus
e: Rutherford ke 1911 ke sona-patra (gold foil) prayog mein alpha kanon ki patli kirn ko sona ki chadar par maara gaya - zyada tar kan seedhe nikal gaye, par kuchh kan bahut tez kone par wapas mud gaye (back-scattering). Isse pata chala ki atom ka bhitar zyada bhaag khaali hai, par beech mein ek bahut chhota, gehra (dense) aur dhan-aaveshit (positively charged) nucleus maujood hai jahan se aane wale dhan kan pratikarshit (repel) hote hain. 'Electrons in raisins' J.J. Thomson ke plum-pudding model ka hissa tha jo is prayog se galat sabit hua; energy subshell aur wave nature matter ke kaam aage ki khojon mein khuli. Exam point: gold foil alpha-scattering prayog (Rutherford, 1911) ne chhota, gehra, dhan-aaveshit nucleus siddh kar diya; atom ka zyada bhaag khaali (empty) space hai.

qe: According to the Bohr-Bury scheme, what is the maximum electron capacity of any principal shell with quantum index 'n'?
qh: बोर-बरी योजना के अनुसार किसी भी मुख्य कोश (Shell) में इलेक्ट्रॉनों की अधिकतम संख्या किस सूत्र से ज्ञात की जाती है?
e: Bohr-Bury scheme ke anusaar kisi bhi mukhya kosth (principal shell) mein electronon ki adhiktam sankhya 2n^2 hoti hai, jahan n us kosth ka kramank hai - isliye K kosth (n=1) mein 2, L (n=2) mein 8, M (n=3) mein 18 aur N (n=4) mein 32 electron ho sakte hain. Ye niyam electronon ke kosthon mein bantware (configuration) ka aadhaar hai; khaas baat yahi hai ki bahari kosth mein 8 se zyada electron nahi bharte aur antim-se-pehle kosth mein 18 se zyada nahi bharte. '2n' ya 'n^2' wale vikalp adhoora ginti dete hain, isliye galat hain. Exam point: kisi bhi shell mein electronon ki adhiktam sankhya = 2n^2 (K 2, L 8, M 18, N 32) - Bohr-Bury niyam.

qe: The thermodynamic phase transition where a solid converts directly into the gaseous vapor phase without melting into a liquid is:
qh: ठोस पदार्थ का बिना द्रव में बदले सीधे वाष्प (गैस) में परिवर्तित हो जाने की प्रक्रिया क्या कहलाती है?
e: Vah bhautik parivartan jismein koi thos (solid) pighal kar drav (liquid) banne ke baad hi bhaap nahi banta, balki seedhe thos se vaasp (vapour/gas) ban jaata hai, use urdhwapaatan (sublimation) kehte hain - jaise camphor (kapoor), naphthalene ki goli, ammonium chloride (naushadar) aur iodine. Sambhavan (condensation) gas ko drav banata hai, vashpeekaran (evaporation) drav ko bhaap banata hai, aur nikeshepan (deposition) bhaap ko seedha thos banata hai (sublimation ka ulta) - isliye ye teeno vikalp galat hain. Isi khaas gun ki wajah se kapoor aur naphthalene ki goli hawa mein khud gayab ho jaati hain. Exam point: sublimation (Urdhwapaatan) = thos se seedha gas, bagair pighal kar drav banne ke; camphor, naphthalene, iodine aur naushadar iske udaharan hain.

qe: Which high-energy state of matter comprises superheated, quasi-neutral, freely moving ionized gases and stripped electrons?
qh: तारों और सूर्य में पाई जाने वाली अत्यधिक गर्म आयनित गैस और मुक्त इलेक्ट्रॉनों से युक्त 'पदार्थ की चौथी अवस्था' कौन सी है?
e: Plasma padaarth ki wo avastha hai jismein gas ke atom superheated hote hue apne electron chhod dete hain aur 'aayaneet' (ionised) gas ke roop mein aaveshit kanon aur mukt electronon ka mishran ban jaate hain, jise quasi-neutral kehte hain kyunki total aavesh lagbhag zero hota hai. Ye gharme-dhara (aur sooraj) aur bijli ki kirnon (lightning) mein milti hai, aur neon lamp, plasma TV aur parmaanu sangat (fusion) prayogon mein bhi istemal hoti hai. Gas mein atom bane rehte hain, BEC (Bose-Einstein Condensate) bahut thandi avastha hai aur fermionic condensate bhi alag; isliye 'plasma' hi sahi jod hai. Exam point: plasma = superheated ionised gas (aaveshit kan + mukt electron), brahmand ki sabse aam avastha; sooraj aur lightning iske udaharan hain.

qe: Atoms of different chemical elements that share the same Mass Number (A) but possess different Atomic Numbers (Z) are:
qh: भिन्न-भिन्न तत्वों के वे परमाणु जिनके परमाणु क्रमांक भिन्न परंतु द्रव्यमान संख्या समान होती है, क्या कहलाते हैं?
e: Isobar (Sam-bhaarik) wo atom hote hain jo alag-alag tatv ke hain, yani unka atomic number (Z) alag hota hai, par mass number (A) saman hota hai - jaise calcium-40 aur argon-40, ya carbon-14 aur nitrogen-14. Inmein proton aur neutron ki kul ginti barabar hoti hai par unka bantavara alag, isliye rasayanik gun bhi alag hote hain. Isotopes ek hi tatv ke hote hain (Z saman), isotones mein neutron barabar hote hain aur isomers keval asthaayi (temporary) nuclear urja-avastha ke bhed dikhate hain - isliye ye vikalp galat hain. Yaad rakhein: isobar ka matlab 'sama-bhaar' (equal weight). Exam point: isobar = alag tatv, saman mass number (jaise Ca-40 aur Ar-40); isotopes = ek hi tatv, alag mass number.

qe: Heisenberg's Uncertainty Principle mathematically states that it is physically impossible to simultaneously determine with precision both:
qh: हाइजेनबर्ग के अनिश्चितता सिद्धांत (Uncertainty Principle) के अनुसार किसी सूक्ष्म कण की किन दो राशियों को एक साथ सटीक नहीं मापा जा सकता?
o: Exact Position (Δx) and Linear Momentum (Δp) of an electron: Δx · Δp ≥ h / (4π)
e: Heisenberg ke anishchitata siddhant (Uncertainty Principle) ke anusaar kisi sookshm kan (jaise electron) ki stithi (position) aur sanveg (momentum) dono ko ek saath poori shuddhi (precision) ke saath nahi jaana ja sakta; ganitiya roop mein deltax . deltap >= h / (4 pi), jahan deltax stithi ki anishchitata, deltap sanveg ki anishchitata aur h Planck niyantrak hai. Iska matlab ye nahi ki hamare upkaran kamzor hain, balki ye sookshm kanon ka mool gun hai - isi wajah se electron ka 'path' ki tarah seedha chalan nahi, balki 'prabalta ghanatv' (probability density) wale orbital ki baat ki jaati hai. Urja-taranga-dairghya, aavesh-spin ya dravyaman-vega wale jod is siddhant ke asli kathan nahi hain. Exam point: Heisenberg ka siddhant = stithi aur sanveg dono ek saath sashuddh nahi (deltax . deltap >= h/4pi); isi karan orbital ki probability wali soch aayi.

qe: What is the physical charge and compositional nature of an ionizing Alpha (α) particle emitted in radioactive decay?
qh: रेडियोधर्मी क्षय में उत्सर्जित होने वाले अल्फा (α) कण की संरचना और आवेश क्या होता है?
o: +2 charge (doubly ionized Helium nucleus: He2+ with 2 protons and 2 neutrons)
e: Alpha kan (alpha) radioaktiv ksharan mein nikalne wala ek bhaari kan hai jiska aavesh +2 hota hai aur ye helium ke nucleus (He2+) ke bilkul barabar hota hai - yani usmein 2 proton aur 2 neutron hote hain, par 2 electron kam hote hain, isliye aavesh dhan (+) rehta hai. Iske vipreet beta kan (beta) ek electron (-1 aavesh) ya positron hota hai aur gamma kirn ek vidyut-chumbakiya taranga (0 aavesh, photon) hoti hai. Alpha kan ki bhedan-shakti (penetrating power) kam par aayanikaran-shakti bahut zyada hoti hai, isliye kaagaz se hi ruk jaata hai. Isliye sahi jod +2 aavesh wala helium nucleus hai. Exam point: alpha kan = +2 aavesh, 2 proton + 2 neutron (helium nucleus ke barabar); beta kan = electron, gamma kirn = photon.

qe: Which orbital quantum number primarily defines the average spatial size and principal energy level of an electron shell?
qh: कौन सी मुख्य क्वांटम संख्या (Principal Quantum Number - n) कक्षक के औसत आकार और मुख्य ऊर्जा स्तर को निर्धारित करती है?
e: Mukhya kvantam sankhya (Principal Quantum Number, n) electron wale kosth (shell) ka kramank batati hai aur isi se us kosth ka aakar (size), parikalpa ki doori aur lagbhag uski urja (energy) tay hoti hai - n ke badhne par kosth bada aur nucleus se door hota hai. Azimuthal (l) sankhya up-kosth ka aakar aur urja-staar, magnetic (ml) sankhya chumbakiya kshetra mein aavartan (orientation) aur spin (ms) sankhya electron ke chakkar (spin) ki disha batati hai. Isliye 'spatial size aur principal energy level' ke liye sahi jod principal quantum number hai. Exam point: principal quantum number n = kosth (shell) ka aakar aur mukhya urja-staar; l = up-kosth ka aakar/shape, ml = orientation, ms = spin.

qe: Which quantum number dictates the three-dimensional geometric shape (s=spherical, p=dumbbell, d=double-dumbbell) of an atomic subshell?
qh: द्विगंशी क्वांटम संख्या (Azimuthal Quantum Number - l) कक्षक के किस गुण को निर्धारित करती है?
o: Three-dimensional spatial shape and orbital angular momentum (l = 0 to n-1)
e: Azimuthal (sah-azimuthal) ya orbital kvantam sankhya (l) kisi bahu-kosth (subshell) ke teen-aayaamiy (three-dimensional) aakar ko tay karti hai - l = 0 par s orbital gol (spherical), l = 1 par p orbital dumble (dumbbell) jaisa, l = 2 par d orbital double-dumbbell aur l = 3 par f orbital zyada jatil aakar leta hai. l ki maan 0 se n-1 tak hoti hai, isliye n=2 par l = 0 ya 1 (keval s aur p) milte hain. 'Spin' ms ka, 'chumbakiya disha' ml ka aur 'kosth ki kshamata' n ka vishay hai - ye baatein is prashn se mel nahi khatin. Exam point: azimuthal quantum number l = orbital/subshell ka 3D aakar (s gol, p dumbbell, d double dumbbell); l = 0 se n-1 tak.

qe: What is the physical significance of the Magnetic Quantum Number (ml) when atoms are placed in external magnetic fields?
qh: चुंबकीय क्वांटम संख्या (Magnetic Quantum Number - ml) कक्षक के किस लक्षण को दर्शाती है?
o: Spatial orientation of orbitals along three-dimensional coordinate axes (ml = -l to +l)
e: Chumbakiya kvantam sankhya (Magnetic Quantum Number, ml) kisi orbital ke bahari (external) chumbakiya kshetra (magnetic field) mein teen-aayaamiy nirdeshak akshon (coordinate axes) ke saath leen (orientation) ko darshata hai - iski maan -l se +l tak hoti hai, isliye p orbital ke teen roop (px, py, pz) aur d orbital ke paanch roop hote hain. Isi karan orbitalon ki sankhya l ke aadhar par 2l+1 hoti hai. Linear velocity, kul urja ke eigenvalues ya nuclear fusion threshold se iska koi sambandh nahi hai - wo dusre vishay hain. Isliye sahi jod 'spatial orientation (ml = -l se +l)' wala hai. Exam point: magnetic quantum number ml = orbital ki bahari chumbakiya kshetra mein disha/leen; maan -l se +l (kul 2l+1 orbital).

qe: Pauli's Exclusion Principle states that no two electrons in the same atom can possess the identical set of four quantum numbers, meaning:
qh: पाउली के अपवर्जन सिद्धांत (Pauli's Exclusion Principle) का मुख्य निष्कर्ष क्या है?
o: An individual orbital can hold a maximum of two electrons, and they must have anti-parallel (opposite) spins (+1/2 and -1/2)
Electrons always fill the highest energy orbitals first
e: Pauli ka apvaadan siddhant (Exclusion Principle) kehta hai ki ek hi atom ke do electron ke chaar kvantam sankhya (n, l, ml, ms) ek jaise nahi ho sakte - iska vyavaharik matlab yahi hai ki ek orbital mein adhiktam do electron reh sakte hain aur unke spin ulte (anti-parallel) hone chahiye, yani +1/2 aur -1/2. Yahi karan hai ki har orbital do electronon se zyada nahi le paata aur electronon ki sankhya 2(2l+1) wale niyam se baandhi hoti hai. 'Sab electron nucleus ko dhakke dete hain', 'sabse zyada urja wale orbital pehle bharte hain' ya 'orbitals degenerate rehte hain' wale kathan galat hain. Exam point: Pauli ka niyam = ek orbital mein adhiktam 2 electron, ulte spin (+1/2 aur -1/2) ke saath; chaar kvantam sankhya saman nahi ho sakti.

qe: The Aufbau Principle ($(n+l)$ rule) dictates that incoming ground-state electrons sequentially occupy orbitals in order of:
qh: आफबाऊ सिद्धांत (Aufbau Principle) के अनुसार इलेक्ट्रॉन कक्षकों में किस क्रम में प्रवेश करते हैं?
o: Increasing orbital energy levels: lower (n+l) values fill first before higher ones
e: Aufbau siddhant (ya (n+l) niyam) ke anusaar base-avastha (ground state) mein electron pehle us orbital mein bharte hain jiska (n+l) man kam hota hai; agar do orbital ka (n+l) barabar ho to jiska n chhota ho wo pehle bharta hai. Isliye 4s (n+l = 4+0 = 4) pehle bharta hai aur 3d (3+2 = 5) baad mein, jisse 19vaan electron 4s mein jaata hai. 'Random' ya 'alphabetical' wale kathan galat hain aur 'ghatati hui orbital size' bhi niyam nahi hai. Isi kram ko yaad karne ka aasan tarika: 1s, 2s, 2p, 3s, 3p, 4s, 3d, 4p, 5s... Exam point: Aufbau ka niyam = pehle kam (n+l) wala orbital bharta hai; barabar (n+l) ho to kam n pehle (isi liye 4s pehle, 3d baad mein).

qe: Hund's Rule of Maximum Multiplicity establishes that when filling degenerate orbitals of equal energy (like px, py, pz):
qh: हुंड के अधिकतम बहुलता के नियम (Hund's Rule) के अनुसार समान ऊर्जा वाले कक्षकों में इलेक्ट्रॉनों का युग्मन (Pairing) कब शुरू होता है?
o: Electrons pair up immediately in the first orbital
Each degenerate orbital is singly occupied with parallel spins before any pairing occurs
e: Hund ke adhiktam bahu-sankhya (maximum multiplicity) ke niyam ke anusaar jab kisi up-kosth ke kai degenerate orbital barabar urja wale khaali ho (jaise px, py, pz), to electron pehle har orbital ko ek-ek karke bharte hain aur sabhi ka spin ek hi disha (parallel) rakhte hain, aur uske baad hi jodne (pairing) ki prakriya shuru hoti hai. Isse atom ki urja sabse kam rehti hai. 'Pehle hi orbital mein jode ban jaayein', 'keval spin-down electron bharein' ya 'nucleus mein gir jaayein' wale kathan is niyam ke vipreet hain. Yahi niyam samjhata hai ki nitrogen ke 2p mein teen abhaav (unpaired) electron kyu hote hain. Exam point: Hund ka niyam = degenerate orbital pehle ek-ek electron se bharte hain (parallel spins), pairing baad mein; isse adhiktam unpaired electrons milte hain.

qe: Why do ground-state Chromium (Z=24) and Copper (Z=29) atoms show anomalous configurations ($Cr: [Ar] 3d^5 4s^1$ and $Cu: [Ar] 3d^{10} 4s^1$)?
qh: क्रोमियम ($Z=24$) और कॉपर ($Z=29$) के इलेक्ट्रॉनिक विन्यास में 4s कक्षक से एक इलेक्ट्रॉन 3d कक्षक में क्यों चला जाता है?
o: Exactly half-filled ($3d^5$) and fully-filled ($3d^{10}$) d-subshells exhibit extra stability due to structural symmetry and high exchange energy
Because the 4s orbital collapses into the nucleus
Due to loss of nuclear charge
e: Chromium (Z=24) aur copper (Z=29) mein adhiktam (anomalous) configuration isliye hoti hai ki aadha bhara (half-filled, 3d^5) aur poora bhara (fully-filled, 3d^10) d-up-kosth adhiktam sthirta deta hai - aisi vyavastha mein badhi hui sameka-vinimay urja (exchange energy) aur golek sthirta (spherical symmetry) milti hai. Isliye Cr [Ar]3d^5 4s^1 aur Cu [Ar]3d^10 4s^1 likhe jaate hain, yani 4s se ek electron 3d mein chala jaata hai. '4s nucleus mein gir jaata hai', 'relativistic mass se bachna' ya 'nuclear charge ka nash' wale kathan vigyaan sammat nahi hain. Exam point: Cr aur Cu ki anomalous configuration = aadhe bhare 3d^5 aur poore bhare 3d^10 ki extra sthirta (exchange energy + symmetry) ke karan.

qe: What is the formula to calculate the total number of Radial Nodes and Angular Nodes in an atomic wave function?
qh: किसी कक्षक में रेडियल नोड्स (Radial Nodes) और कोणीय नोड्स (Angular Nodes) ज्ञात करने का सही सूत्र क्या है?
o: Radial nodes = l, Angular nodes = n - 1
Radial nodes = (n - l - 1), Angular nodes = l, Total nodes = (n - 1)
Radial nodes = n, Angular nodes = l
e: Kisi bhi atomic wave function mein nodes ki ginti ke teen formula hain: koniy (radial) nodes = n - l - 1, up-koniy (angular) nodes = l, aur kul nodes = (n - 1). Angular nodes orbital ke aakar se jude hote hain (s mein 0, p mein 1, d mein 2) aur radial nodes nucleus ke aas-paas electron milne ki sambhavna (probability) shunya hone ki golakaar satahein hoti hain. Formula yaad rakhne ka aasan tarika: kul = radial + angular, aur kul hamesha (n-1) hi rehta hai. Baaki teen vikalp (l aur n-1 ka ulta jod, 2l+1, ya n aur l) samakaran ke roop mein galat hain. Exam point: radial nodes = n-l-1, angular nodes = l, total nodes = n-1; s orbital mein 0 angular nodes hote hain.

qe: How many total, radial, and angular nodes are present in a 3p atomic orbital?
qh: एक 3p कक्षक (3p orbital) में कुल नोड्स, रेडियल नोड्स और कोणीय नोड्स की संख्या क्रमशः कितनी होती है?
e: 3p orbital ke liye n = 3 aur l = 1 (p up-kosth) hota hai - isliye kul nodes = n - 1 = 2, radial nodes = n - l - 1 = 3 - 1 - 1 = 1, aur angular nodes = l = 1. Isi tarah 2p mein radial 0 aur angular 1 hote hain, aur 3s mein radial 2 aur angular 0. Node ki ginti se orbital ka aakar, urja-staar aur nucleus se door milne wale kshetra ka pata chalta hai. Formula galat jod laga kar 'radial 2/angular 0', 'radial 0/angular 1' ya 'total 3' likhna bhi aam galti hai, isliye pehle n aur l likh kar hi ginti karni chahiye. Exam point: 3p orbital mein n=3, l=1 se total 2 nodes, radial 1 aur angular 1 hote hain.

qe: Nuclides belonging to different chemical elements possessing the EXACT same number of Neutrons (A - Z) are:
qh: भिन्न-भिन्न तत्वों के वे परमाणु जिनमें न्यूट्रॉनों की संख्या (A - Z) बिल्कुल समान होती है, क्या कहलाते हैं?
e: Sam-neutronic (isotones) wo nuklaid hote hain jo alag-alag tatvon ke hain par unmein neutronon ki ginti (A - Z) bilkul barabar hoti hai - jaise carbon-14 (6 proton, 8 neutron) aur nitrogen-15 (7 proton, 8 neutron), ya silicon-30 aur phosphorus-31. Inmein mass number aur atomic number alag hote hain, keval neutron ki ginti saman hoti hai. Iske vipreet isotopes ek hi tatv se jude hote hain (Z saman), isobar mein mass number saman hota hai, aur isomers mein keval asthaayi nuclear urja-staar ka bhed hota hai - in teeno ka isotones se mel nahi hai. Yaad rakhein: isotone ka taalluq neutronon ki ginti se hai. Exam point: isotones (sam-neutronic) = alag tatv, neutronon ki ginti (A-Z) saman; isobar mein A saman aur isotope mein Z saman hota hai.

qe: What are 'Isodiaphers' in nuclear physics?
qh: परमाणु भौतिकी में 'आइसोडायफर्स' (Isodiaphers) किन्हें कहा जाता है?
o: Nuclides possessing the identical difference between neutrons and protons: (N - Z) or (A - 2Z)
Atoms with the same nuclear charge
e: Isodiafer (isodiaphers) wo nuklaid hote hain jinke neutron aur proton ki ginti ka antar (N - Z) ya (A - 2Z) bilkul barabar hota hai - jaise thorium-234 aur uranium-238 mein ye antar saman hota hai. Inhe samajhne ka fayda yahi hai ki alpha ksharan (decay) mein N-Z ka antar nahi badalta, isliye aise nuklaid ek hi ksharan-shreni ka hissa maane jaate hain. 'Saman mass number' isobar ka lakshan hai, 'mirror symmetry wale molecule' koi bhaaritiki shabd nahi hai aur 'saman nuclear charge' isotopes ka lakshan hai - isliye ye teeno vikalp galat hain. Exam point: isodiaphers = ve nuklaid jinke (N - Z) ya (A - 2Z) ka antar saman ho; alpha ksharan mein ye antar nahi badalta.

qe: Species (atoms, ions, or molecules) that possess the exact same total number of electrons are classified as:
qh: वे परमाणु या आयन जिनमें इलेक्ट्रॉनों की कुल संख्या बिल्कुल समान होती है, क्या कहलाते हैं?
o: Isoelectronic Species (e.g., N3-, O2-, F-, Ne, Na+, Mg2+, Al3+ all have 10 electrons)
e: Jin spishiz (atom, aayan ya molecule) mein kul electronon ki ginti bilkul barabar hoti hai, unhe sam-electronik (isoelectronic) species kehte hain - jaise N3-, O2-, F-, Ne, Na+, Mg2+ aur Al3+ sabhi mein 10 electron hote hain, kyunki inka electron dhancha neon jaisa hi hota hai. Aisi species ke aakar (size) aur kuchh gun milte-julte hote hain, isliye ise tulna (comparison) karne mein istemal karte hain. Isobar (saman mass number), isotope (saman proton) aur isotone (saman neutron) wale vikalp electronon ki ginti ke niyam nahi batate - isliye wo galat hain. Exam point: isoelectronic species = kul electronon ki ginti saman (jaise N3-, O2-, F-, Ne, Na+, Mg2+, Al3+ - sab mein 10 electron); yaad rakhne ka aadhaar electron ki ginti hai, proton ya neutron ki nahi.

qe: Why are transition metal ions like $Fe^{3+}$ ($3d^5$, 5 unpaired electrons) strongly Paramagnetic while $Zn^{2+}$ ($3d^{10}$) is Diamagnetic?
qh: Fe3+ आयन चुंबकीय क्षेत्र में आकर्षित (अनुचुंबकीय) क्यों होता है जबकि Zn2+ आयन प्रतिकर्षित (प्रतिचुंबकीय) होता है?
o: Paramagnetism is produced by unpaired electrons possessing net magnetic moments, whereas diamagnetic species have all electrons paired up
e: Paramagnetism un atomon ya aayanon mein dikhta hai jinke paas abhaav (unpaired) electron hote hain - ye electron apna chumbakiya aaghoorn (magnetic moment) banate hain, isliye aise padarth chumbak ki taraf aakarshit hote hain; Fe3+ (3d^5, paanch unpaired electron) iska achha udaharan hai. Diamagnetism un padarthon mein hota hai jinke sabhi electron jode (paired) mein ho jaate hain, isliye unka kul chumbakiya aaghoorn lagbhag zero ho jaata hai aur wo chumbak se door hate hain - Zn2+ (3d^10) iska udaharan hai. Zn2+ mein d orbital khali nahi hota balki poora bhara hota hai, Fe3+ alpha kan nahi chhodta, aur nuclear mass ka chumbakatv se koi sambandh nahi - isliye wo vikalp galat hain. Exam point: unpaired electron wale kan paramagnetic (Fe3+) aur sab jode wale diamagnetic (Zn2+) hote hain; chumbakiya aaghoorn ka asli karan unpaired electron hain.

qe: The 'Spin-Only' magnetic moment (μ) of a transition metal ion is calculated in Bohr Magnetons (BM) using which formula?
qh: अयुग्मित इलेक्ट्रॉनों (n) वाले किसी संक्रमण धातु आयन का चुंबकीय आघूर्ण (Magnetic Moment - μ) किस सूत्र से निकाला जाता है?
e: Kisi san-kriya (transition) dhatu aayan ke 'spin-only' chumbakiya aaghoorn (magnetic moment) ko Bohr Magnetons (BM) mein nikaalne ka formula mu = sqrt[n(n + 2)] hai, jahan n abhaav (unpaired) electronon ki sankhya hai - jaise Fe3+ mein n = 5, isliye mu = sqrt[5 x 7] = sqrt35 lagbhag 5.92 BM. 'sqrt(n+2)', 'n(n+1)' ya '2n+1' wale vikalp is formula ke roop nahi hain aur galat maan dete hain. Dhyan rakhein ki ye formula keval un aayanon ke liye theek chalti hai jahan orbital motion ka yogdaan lagbhag khatm ho jaata hai, isliye ise 'spin-only' formula kehte hain. Exam point: spin-only magnetic moment mu = sqrt[n(n+2)] BM; n = unpaired electron ki ginti (Fe3+ mein 5 se lagbhag 5.92 BM).

qe: Which spectral emission line series of atomic hydrogen falls in the human Visible light spectrum?
qh: हाइड्रोजन परमाणु के उत्सर्जन स्पेक्ट्रम की कौन सी श्रेणी दृश्य प्रकाश (Visible Light) क्षेत्र में पड़ती है?
e: Hydrogen ke spektrum (emission spectrum) mein Balmer shreni (series) wo hai jismein electron n = 3, 4, 5, 6 ya usse zyada kosthon se gir kar n = 2 par aata hai - isi shreni ki tarang-dairghya (wavelength) dyshya (visible) prakash ki seema mein aati hai, isliye ise aankhon se dekha ja sakta hai aur H-alpha laal rang ki pehchan banata hai. Lyman shreni (n = 1 par aana) paraben-neeli (ultraviolet) mein, aur Paschen (n=3), Brackett (n=4), Pfund (n=5) wali shreniyaan infrared (prakshaddhvani) mein aati hain - isliye wo vikalp galat hain. Isi shreni ke aadhar par hydrogen ki urja-staar vyavastha samjhi gayi. Exam point: Balmer series (n=2 par electron ka aana) hydrogen spektrum ka dyshya (visible) bhaag hai; Lyman ultraviolet aur Paschen-Brackett infrared mein aata hai.

qe: Which synthetic radioisotope of Cobalt emitting high-energy penetrating Gamma rays is deployed in oncology radiotherapy?
qh: कैंसर के इलाज और ट्यूमर को नष्ट करने के लिए कोबाल्ट के किस रेडियोधर्मी समस्थानिक (Gamma Emitter) का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Cobalt-60 (60Co) ek synthetic radioisotope hai jo kobalt-59 ko neutronon se bomb kar banaya jaata hai - ye high-energy gaama kirnein chhodta hai, isliye oncology (kainkar chikitsa) mein radiotherapy ke liye istemal hota hai aur gamma camera/stadeekaran (sterilisation) mein bhi kaam aata hai. Iska ardh-ayu lagbhag 5.27 saal hai, isliye samay-samay par naya source bharana padta hai. Cobalt-57, 58 aur 59 aise high-energy therapy source ke liye istemal nahi hote (59 sthir hai). Isliye sahi jod Cobalt-60 (60Co) hai. Exam point: kanker radiotherapy mein gaama kirnein dene wala radioisotope = Cobalt-60 (60Co), ardh-ayu lagbhag 5.27 saal (gamma source).

qe: The radioactive cosmogenic isotope Carbon-14 (half-life approx 5,730 years) is deployed in radiocarbon dating to determine the age of:
qh: कार्बन-14 रेडियोधर्मी डेटिंग (अर्धायु 5,730 वर्ष) का उपयोग किसकी आयु निर्धारित करने के लिए किया जाता है?
o: Dead organic archaeological remains (wood, bones, fossils, textiles)
e: Radiocarbon dating (carbon-14 vidhi) jeevit praani ke marne ke baad ke samay ka pata lagane ke liye hoti hai - jeete hue poudhe-sharir mein carbon-14 ka anupat hawa ke carbon-14 jitna hi bana rehta hai, par mrityu ke baad wo dhatu (decay) hokar dhire-dhire ghatta jaata hai; iske ardh-ayu (half-life) lagbhag 5,730 saal hone se lakdi, haddi, faasil (fossil), kapde aur anya jaivik (organic) avsheshon ki aayu nikaali ja sakti hai. Iska istemal aagney (igneous) chattanon ke liye nahi hota (unmein carbon nahi bachta), na samudri saline-pan ya ulkapindon ki aayu ke liye - unke liye uranium-lead ya potassium-argon jaisi vidhiyan hoti hain. Exam point: carbon-14 dating = dead organic remains (lakdi, haddi, fossil, kapda) ki aayu lagbhag 5,730 saal ke ardh-aayu wali ksharan se nikaalna; sthir chattanon ke liye ye vidhi nahi chalti.

qe: What substance is chemically formulated as 'Heavy Water' ($D_2O$), used as a neutron moderator and coolant in nuclear fission reactors?
qh: परमाणु रिएक्टरों में न्यूट्रॉनों की गति को धीमा करने वाले मंदक (Moderator) के रूप में प्रयुक्त 'भारी जल' का सूत्र क्या है?
e: 'Bhaari jal' (Heavy Water) ka rasayanik naam deuterium oxide (D2O ya 2H2O) hai - ismein saadharan hydrogen ke bajaay deuterium (2H1, ek proton aur ek neutron wala hydrogen isotope) hota hai, isliye iska dravyaman saadharan paani se thoda zyada hota hai. Iska mukhya istemal parmaanu bhatti ke neutron-sanchodhak (moderator) aur shitalak (coolant) ke roop mein hota hai, aur ise Canada ke CANDU reactors mein bhi istemal karte hain. Tritium oxide (T2O) alag radioaktiv padarth hai, H2O2 ek virok (oxidiser) hai, aur distilled rain water saadharan paani hi hota hai - in teeno ka bhaari paani se koi talluq nahi. Exam point: Heavy Water = deuterium oxide (D2O/2H2O); neutron moderator aur coolant ke roop mein parmaanu bhatti mein istemal hota hai.

qe: Which elements are utilized in the safety 'Control Rods' of nuclear reactors to capture excess thermal neutrons and regulate the chain reaction?
qh: परमाणु भट्टी में विखंडन की श्रृंखला अभिक्रिया को नियंत्रित करने के लिए न्यूट्रॉन अवशोषक छड़ें किसकी बनी होती हैं?
e: Parmaanu bhatti (nuclear reactor) mein 'niyantran chhad (Control Rods)' ka kaam fizool (excess) neutronon ko sokh kar shrankhala-kriya (chain reaction) ki dar (rate) ko niyamit rakhna hai - iske liye cadmium (Cd) aur boron (B) ka istemal hota hai, kyunki ye neutronon ko aasaani se grahan (capture) kar lete hain. Reactor ko tez karne ke liye chhadein thodi bahar nikaali jaati hain aur dheema karne ke liye andar daali jaati hain. Rddhiragni (enriched uranium) eendhan hota hai, graphite aur bhaari paani neutron-sanchodhak (moderator) hote hain, aur lead-copper se akhbar-khaneem (shielding) banti hai - ye dhanche control rods ke nahi hain. Exam point: control rods = cadmium (Cd) aur boron (B), neutron sokh kar chain reaction niyamit karte hain; uranium eendhan aur graphite/bhaari paani moderator hote hain.

qe: Which naturally occurring isotope of Uranium is fissile and undergoes controlled nuclear chain reaction in nuclear power stations?
qh: परमाणु ऊर्जा संयंत्रों में विद्युत उत्पादन के लिए प्रयुक्त होने वाला यूरेनियम का मुख्य विखंडनीय समस्थानिक कौन सा है?
e: Parmaanu bijli-gharon (nuclear power stations) mein uranium ke kul teen prakrutik samasthaanikon (isotopes) mein se sirf Uranium-235 (U-235) hi fisile (fissile) hai, yani ye dheeme neutronon se takra kar do halke nucleuson mein toot kar bahut urja deta hai aur aage neutron chhodta hai - isse niyamit shrankhala-kriya (chain reaction) chalti hai. Iska prakrutik ansh (abundance) keval lagbhag 0.7% hai, isliye reektar ke liye ise samvardhit (enriched) karna padta hai. Uranium-238 (99.3% ansh) seedha fissile nahi hai, 234 bahut kam matara mein hota hai aur 239 kisi anya kriya se banta hai - in teeno ka fissile swabhaav nahi hai. Exam point: fissile isotope = Uranium-235 (lagbhag 0.7% prakrutik ansh), jo niyamit chain reaction deta hai; U-238 (99.3%) seedha fissile nahi hai.

qe: What is an electron's de Broglie wavelength (λ = h / mv) primarily dependent upon?
qh: डी ब्रोगली के अनुसार किसी गतिशील इलेक्ट्रॉन की पदार्थ-तरंगदैर्ध्य (λ) किस पर निर्भर करती है?
o: Planck's constant divided by its Linear Momentum (p = mv)
e: De Broglie ke anusaar har gatishil kan (particle) ke saath tarang (wave) juda hota hai, jiski tarang-dairghya lambda = h / mv = h / p hoti hai - yani ye Planck niyantrak (h) ko kan ke sanveg (momentum p = dravyaman x veg) se bhaag dene par milti hai. Isliye bhaari ya tez chalne wale kanon ki de Broglie tarang-dairghya bahut chhoti hoti hai aur halke-dheele electronon ki badi, jise eksperiment mein dakhal (diffraction) se dekha gaya. Vaayumandaliya daab (barometric pressure), nuclear sthitij urja (electrostatic potential) ya chumbakiya spin se iski ginti tay nahi hoti - isliye wo vikalp galat hain. Exam point: de Broglie tarang-dairghya lambda = h/mv = h/p; sanveg badhne par tarang-dairghya ghatati hai (electromagnetic microscope ka aadhaar).

qe: Why do inner-shell core electrons cause a 'Shielding Effect' (Screening Effect), lowering the effective nuclear charge ($Z_{eff}$) felt by valence electrons?
qh: आंतरिक कोश के इलेक्ट्रॉन बाहरी वैलेंस इलेक्ट्रॉनों पर नाभिक के आकर्षण को कम क्यों कर देते हैं (परिरक्षण प्रभाव / Screening Effect)?
o: Inner electrons absorb all incoming visible photons
Inner core electrons repel outer valence electrons electrostatically, partially canceling the positive nuclear pull ($Z_{eff} = Z - σ$)
e: 'Pardaa ya chhaayankan (shielding/screening) prabhav' isliye hota hai ki nucleus ke nazdeek rehne wale andaruni kosth (inner shell) ke electron bahari (outer) costh ke electronon par apna rin (negative) aavesh daal kar nucleus ke dhan aavesh (positive pull) ka kuchh hissa kaat lete hain - isliye bahari electron par asar karne wala prabhavi nuclear aavesh (Zeff) kul aavesh (Z) se kam ho jaata hai: Zeff = Z - sigma. Isi karan bahari electron nucleus se kam mazbooti se bandha hota hai aur aasaani se nikal jaata hai (aayankaran urja ghatati hai). Andaruni kosth mein dravyaman nahi hota ya photons sokhne ki baat is siddhant ka hissa nahi hai, aur nuclear fusion ka is se koi sambandh nahi. Exam point: shielding/screening effect = andaruni electron nucleus ke khinchaav ko kam kar dete hain (Zeff = Z - sigma); isi karan bahari electron aasaani se nikal jaate hain.

qe: According to the Einstein Photoelectric Equation ($hν = Φ + KE_{max}$), what happens if the incident light frequency falls below the 'Threshold Frequency' ($ν_0$)?
qh: प्रकाश-विद्युत प्रभाव (Photoelectric Effect) में यदि आपतित प्रकाश की आवृत्ति देहली आवृत्ति (Threshold Frequency - ν0) से कम हो तो क्या होगा?
o: No photoelectrons are ejected from the metal surface, regardless of how high the light intensity or duration is
Electrons are emitted with zero velocity
e: Einstein ke prakaash-vidyut samikaran (photoelectric equation) h nu = Phi + KEmax ke anusaar metal ki satah par girne wale prakaash ki aavritti (frequency) nu ko agar dehli aavritti (threshold frequency nu0) se kam ho, to metal se ek bhi photoelectron bahar nahi nikalta - chahe prakaash ki teevrata (intensity) kitni bhi badi ho ya kitna hi samay tak giraaya jaaye. Aisa isliye hota hai ki har electron ko nikalne ke liye kam se kam nirvaachan urja (work function Phi) chahiye, jo ek hi photon ki urja (h nu) se milti hai; photons ki sankhya se ek-ek electron ko milne wali urja nahi badhti. Threshold se upar frequency hone par nikalne wale electronon ki gati (velocity) badhti hai, aur intensity badhne par keval electronon ki sankhya badhti hai. Exam point: threshold frequency se kam aavritti par photoelectron bahar nahi nikalta, chahe intensity kitni bhi ho; frequency urja tay karti hai aur intensity ginti.

qe: Why is the 1s orbital mathematically and geometrically considered 'Isotropic' and non-directional?
qh: 1s परमाणु कक्षक को गैर-दिशात्मक और पूरी तरह से गोलाकार (Spherical) क्यों माना जाता है?
o: It possesses multiple planar angular nodes
It spins in both directions simultaneously
Its Azimuthal quantum number is zero ($l=0$), making its wave function dependent solely on radial distance (r) and independent of angular coordinates (θ, φ)
e: 1s orbital ko isotropik (sab dishaon mein samaan) aur non-directional kaha jaata hai kyunki usmein azimuthal quantum number l = 0 hota hai - isse orbital ka koi koniy (angular) hissa nahi banta, isliye uska wave function keval nucleus se doori (r) par nirbhar karta hai aur koniy nirdeshankon (theta, phi) par nahi. Isi karan 1s orbital ka aakar ek golakaar baadal (spherical cloud) jaisa dikhta hai aur ise kisi disha mein adhik ya kam nahi mila jaata. Gravity se patan, kai planar nodes hona ya dono dishaon mein ek saath spin karna - ye teeno vigyaan sammat nahi hain, kyunki nodes ki ginti l aur n ke aadhar par tay hoti hai aur 1s mein 0 radial aur 0 angular node hota hai. Exam point: 1s orbital isotropik/spherical hai kyunki l = 0 (keval r par nirbhar); s orbital hamesha ball jaisa hota hai, kisi doosri disha ki jhuk wala nahi.

qe: Which noble gas element possesses only 2 electrons filling its outermost valence shell, completely lacking a full octet yet remaining chemically inert?
qh: वह कौन सी एकमात्र अक्रिय गैस (Noble Gas) है जिसके बाह्यतम कोश में 8 के बजाय केवल 2 इलेक्ट्रॉन (डुप्लेट) होते हैं?
e: Helium (He, 1s^2) ek aisa mahan (noble) gas hai jiska bahari kosth mein keval 2 electron hote hain - yahi K kosth ki bhar-kshamata hai, isliye ye poore octet (8 electron) ke bajaay 'duet' (2 electron) wali vyavastha se hi sthir ho jaata hai aur kisi anya tatv se kriya nahi karta. Neon (2,8), Argon (2,8,8) aur Krypton (2,8,18,8) ke bahari kosth mein 8 electron hote hain, isliye unka sthirta niyam saadharan octet (8) wala hi hai. Isliye Helium hi aisa udaharan hai jo bina poore octet ke bhi rasayanik roop se nishkriya (inert) rehta hai. Exam point: Helium (1s^2) ke bahari kosth mein keval 2 electron hain - K kosth ki kshamata 2 hi hai, isliye 'duet' rule se sthir aur inert hai; baaki noble gases poore octet wale hain.

qe: What is the radioactive, carcinogenic noble gas released from deep soil and rock uranium decay that accumulates in basements?
qh: मिट्टी और चट्टानों में यूरेनियम के क्षय से रिसने वाली कौन सी भारी रेडियोधर्मी अक्रिय गैस फेफड़ों के कैंसर का कारण बन सकती है?
e: Radon (222Rn) ek radioaktiv mahan (noble) gas hai jo bhoomi aur chattanon mein uranium ke ksharan (decay) se banta hai - iska ksharan aage alpha kan chhod kar polonium tak pahunchta hai. Ye bhaari gas hai, isliye taha-khaanon (basements) aur band kamron mein jama ho jaati hai aur saans ke zariye andar jaakar khaas taur par pheri-teeki (lungs) ke kanker ka khatra badha deti hai; isi liye ise seh-taapa (carcinogenic) maana jaata hai aur ghar-home radon pareekshan ki salah di jaati hai. Krypton, xenon aur argon ke stable isotopes hote hain jo aise uranium ksharan se khoon ke liye nahi jane jaate. Exam point: uranium ksharan se banti radioaktiv noble gas = Radon (222Rn); taha-khaanon mein jama hokar lungs ke kanker ka khatra badhati hai.
